claim: On 2022-11-10 EC2 Fleet added the price-capacity-optimized Spot allocation strategy, which looks at both price and capacity to pick the Spot pools least likely to be interrupted that have the lowest possible price; before it, the existing allocation strategies in EC2 Auto Scaling and EC2 Fleet were lowest-price and capacity-optimized.

evidence.quote: | [price-capacity-optimized allocation strategy for Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-fleet-allocation-strategy.html) | An EC2 Fleet that uses the `price-capacity-optimized` allocation strategy looks at both price and capacity to select the Spot Instances pools that are the least likely to be interrupted and have the lowest possible price. | November 10, 2022 |
The existing allocation strategies available in Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling and Amazon EC2 Fleet are called “lowest-price” and “capacity-optimized”.
